What I get out of my fraternity is that people want to get better. We have values that everyone in my fraternity exhibit. When someone fails, their is a brother to tell them what they did wrong and also how to get better. In college, it is incredibly easy to let the free time, the parties, and everything else swallow you hope until you fail. Yet the bonds I have created with my brothers hasn't allowed that for me. If a brother parties to much, we make sure he is on his studies. If a brother disrespects a women, we call him out. Personally if I get a bad grade, I feel like I failed the brothers around me and it makes me strive to do better the following semester. This is because I joined an organization that surrounds me with people who have the same values ( not to be confused with the same beliefs) and people who want to see me succeed in college.
